t: You're at Soper Lane, a historic street in the City of London. It is no longer a street you can walk, but the name survives in the records. Robert Brooke, a goldsmith who died in 1613, is recorded as living here, described as a goldsmith of Soper Lane. That places a working craftsman in this part of the City in the early seventeenth century. The material says little else, so that is the story I can tell.
